stemMarkdown: The HCF of two numbers is 12 and their LCM is 180. If one number is 36, what is the other number?
solutionMarkdown:
The product of two numbers equals the product of their HCF and LCM. Hence, we have: 
$$36 \times x = 12 \times 180.$$ Solving for \(x\), we get:
$$x = \frac{12 \times 180}{36} = 60.$$
Thus, the other number is 60.
altSolutionMarkdown: One can also directly use the formula \(\text{lcm}(a,b) \times \text{hcf}(a,b) = a \times b\), and solving for \(b\) gives the same result.
